title: Multiversal External Game Projection Contract

implementation_scope.purpose: Define a deterministic provider-neutral external-game projection contract for Multiversal Character, Creature, Item, Action, Condition, Encounter, Scene, Vehicle and Rule-reference objects while Multiversal remains canonical authority and external VTTs remain read-only clients/projections at this tranche boundary.
authorized: provider-neutral projection kinds Character, Creature, Item, Action, Condition, Encounter, Scene, Vehicle and RuleReference
opaque canonical source-object references sufficient to identify what is being projected without defining external-object mappings, versioning or synchronization semantics
deterministic projection field ordering and deterministic receipts independent of supplied projection or field ordering
explicit projection availability states present, redacted and unsupported so hidden or unavailable information is never manufactured
projection metadata that preserves visibility scope, ownership reference, consent requirement and GM-authority requirement without implementing a permission engine
explicit references among projected objects using canonical Multiversal references only, with no external identifier mapping
acceptance-first proof that the provider-neutral contract compiles and behaves identically on self-hosted Linux and Windows before production mutation is unlocked
not_authorized: vendor selection, ranking, provider-specific schemas or VTI-09 platform commitment
credential use, external account mutation, provider activation, adapter implementation, package publication or external synchronization mutation
canonical game-state mutation or treating an external VTT as rules/campaign authority
external-object mapping, fingerprints, version negotiation, stale/conflict handling, reconnect, deduplication or tombstones reserved to VTI-03
rules actions, rolls, attacks, checks, powers, initiative, reactions or resolution bridging reserved to VTI-04
platform-native character sheet, compendium, map, scene, token, wall, lighting or SDK implementation reserved to later VTI tranches
permission-engine implementation or hidden-information bypass; visibility, ownership, consent and GM authority remain preserved constraints
durable VTI persistence, a new migration or external synchronization ledger
provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment

acceptance_red.failure_reason: VTI-02 production contract module was intentionally absent on the acceptance-only head.

next_action: Implement only the bounded VTI-02 provider-neutral production contract on application PR #416 after this RED-unlock governance gate passes, then require exact-head Linux/Windows GREEN and deterministic comparator PASS before merge.
